name: Wasted Chef
summary: Prepare the finest dishes the judges have ever tasted or sabotage your rivals until their culinary creations become disasters. Compete in the most chaotic cooking competition ever created in this multiplayer party game for up to 4 players, and prove you have what it takes to become the Wasted Chef.
